translations.title: Naruto OVA 9: Chunin Exam on Fire! and Naruto vs. Konohamaru!
translations.overview: Naruto faces off against his old pupil Konohamaru in a tournament during the chuunin entrance exams.
迫る世界の危機…第四次忍界大戦に備え、戦力アップを目的に中忍試験が実施されることになった。火影を目指す木ノ葉の里の下忍・木ノ葉丸も中忍試験を受けることになるが、最終試験であこがれの忍者、ナルトと対決することに！

episodes.title: Uragano! La leggenda dell’istituto Konoha!
episodes.synopsis: This OVA is based on the second Naruto Shippuden Ending sung by Aluto, Michi ~ To you All. This Ending, in which the characters from the Naruto series are dressed in high-school uniforms, was much appreciated by fans, who therefore requested a special episode for this Ending. It's not really an episode, it's more like a scan-anime, in other words, images from a manga scroll by, and Japanese dubbers take charge of telling the story.
